import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double minDiff = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        long answerB = 0;
        long answerA = 0;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            long aCandidate1 = (x * b) / y;
            long aCandidate2 = aCandidate1 + 1;

            checkAndUpdate(b, aCandidate1, x, y, minDiffHolder);
            checkAndUpdate(b, aCandidate2, x, y, minDiffHolder);
        }

        System.out.println(answerA + "/" + answerB);
    }

    static class MinDiffHolder {
        double minDiff = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        long b = 0;
        long a = 0;
    }

    static MinDiffHolder minDiffHolder = new MinDiffHolder();

    static void checkAndUpdate(long b, long a, long x, long y, MinDiffHolder holder) {
        double diff = Math.abs((double)a / b - (double)x / y);
        if (diff + 1e-15 < holder.minDiff) {
            holder.minDiff = diff;
            holder.b = b;
            holder.a = a;
        }
    }
}
